exposure: Prehospital administration of oxytocin by paramedics
outcome: Time from oxytocin administration to placenta delivery
cohort: 350 women who had out-of-hospital births attended by the Queensland Ambulance Service paramedics between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2018.
finding: Oxytocin administration by paramedics in out-of-hospital births was common (63.4%), well-accepted, and not associated with documented adverse events or side effects.
